game.name: Off The Road
game.desc: Open-world off-road driving sandbox by DogByte Games, running natively on handheld Linux. The port replaces the Android runtime with a native one: an ELF so-loader, a JNI bridge, OpenSL ES over SDL audio and the game's own xGen/bgfx GLES2 renderer adopting the loader's context. Game data is extracted from the player's own APK on first launch.
